blocks.source_text: UGHH!!! DAMMIT!!! I SHOULD HAVE WENT FOR A THOUSAND BUCKS!
blocks.translation: ARGH!!! CHẾT TIỆT!!! Lẽ ra mình phải cược 1.000 đô!

blocks.source_text: I COULD'VE WON $2,000! I JUST LOST $1,000!
blocks.translation: Mình đã có thể thắng 2.000 đô! Thế là vừa mất toi 1.000 đô!

blocks.notes: Phone-vibration effect; repeated instances represented by one block.

blocks.source_text: UGH. WHO'S INTERRUPTING ME DURING MY LUCKY STREAK?
blocks.translation: Hừ. Ai phá chuỗi may mắn của mình thế?

blocks.source_text: DAMN BITCH. I'LL SEE ABOUT YOU.
blocks.translation: Con mụ chết tiệt. Để xem rồi biết tay.

blocks.notes: Speech bubble is cut off at the page boundary and continues on page 25.
